ideas.children_he: כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי הָעוֹלָם נִקְרָאִים לַעֲבֹד אֶת ה׳ בְּשִׂמְחָה וְלָבוֹא לְפָנָיו בְּשִׁירָה.
ideas.children_en: Everyone in the world is called to serve God joyfully and come before Him singing.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ בָּרָא אוֹתָנוּ, וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַמּוֹ וְצֹאנוֹ שֶׁהוּא דּוֹאֵג לוֹ.
ideas.children_en: God made us, and we are His people and the flock He cares for.

ideas.children_he: נָבוֹא לְבֵית ה׳ בְּתוֹדָה וּבִתְהִלָּה וּנְבָרֵךְ אֶת שְׁמוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Let us enter God's house with thanks and praise and bless His name.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ טוֹב, וְחַסְדּוֹ וְנֶאֱמָנוּתוֹ נִמְשָׁכִים לְכָל הַדּוֹרוֹת.
ideas.children_en: God is good, and His kindness and faithfulness last through every generation.
